title: On Some Unification Theorems: Yang-Baxter Systems; Johnson-Tzitzeica Theorem
content: The Yang–Baxter equation emerged from a theoretical physics article written by the Nobel laureate C.N. Yang and from statistical mechanics work of R.J. Baxter. Attempts to unify the algebra structures and the coalgebra structures have eventually led to new solutions of the Yang-Baxter equation. But, in order to capture the information encapsulated in modules over algebras and comodules over coalgebras, we will need some kind of extensions of the Yang-Baxter equation, called Yang-Baxter systems. Also, the Tzitzeica-Johnson theorem is generalized in the curent paper.
